tools.name: recall
tools.description: Retrieve relevant persisted memory using semantic, temporal, priority, or hybrid routing. Governance: requires reason (10–200 chars). Rate limit: 20/min.

tools.name: save_to_synapse
tools.description: Persist memory with encryption at rest, sanitization, and deduplication controls.

tools.name: process_text
tools.description: Extract candidate memories from free-form text with governance filters and sanitization.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search persisted memory across agent scopes using full-text matching. Governance: requires reason (10–200 chars) because results contain plaintext content.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check service availability, engine version, and storage health. Public method.

tools.name: initialize_context
tools.description: Initialize a persistent memory context for a conversation or agent session. Returns REDACTED metadata by default (detail="summary"). Use detail="full" with a reason (10–200 chars) to retrieve plaintext content under MEMORY_EXPORT_GOVERNANCE_V1.

tools.name: save_memory
tools.description: Save a memory entry to the persistent store. Alias of save_to_synapse.

tools.name: store_memory
tools.description: Store structured memory with metadata and trust scoring.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Recall persisted memory by query. Alias of recall.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List memory metadata with pagination and governance limits.

tools.name: memory_feedback
tools.description: Submit feedback to adjust trust scoring for stored memories.

tools.name: neural_handover
tools.description: Transfer contextual state between agents with continuity controls.

tools.name: slo_report
tools.description: Return uptime and SLO metrics for the MCP service.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
